integrity_notes: The central-edge non-sustainability of proper double stars was established in the motivating paper and is not claimed as new. Independent mathematical assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only adjacency-spectral one-edge exchanges of finite simple double stars with positive leaf counts are classified. Distinct labelled exchanges are counted separately. No multi-edge shifts or arbitrary trees are covered. Historical priority is provisional.
title: The complete spectral edge-exchange profile of double stars
